values.heading: Principles
values.lede: Each one earned the hard way — and pinned above my desk.

items.title: Built to last.
items.body: Holds up over time. Room to grow without disrupting what works.

items.title: Clarity before code.
items.body: Pin down the details first. Code comes after they're settled. Fewer rewrites, no surprises later.

items.title: Always in the loop.
items.body: Updates as we go, demos when there's something to show. Heads-up early on anything that shifts the plan.

work.heading: Work
work.lede: A few projects I've designed and built.
work.footnote: ↑ everything I do, I do with care.

items.label: Astro · Tailwind
items.outcome: Loads in under a second · perfect speed scores
items.summary: Rebuilt a slow, template-heavy marketing site from scratch — clean design, loads in under a second on every device, and a CMS the team can update without touching code.

items.label: Next.js · OpenAI · pgvector
items.outcome: Searches 40k help docs · cites every answer · knows when to ask a human
items.summary: Built a support assistant grounded in the client's existing help docs (about 40k pages). It drafts answers with sources for every claim and quietly passes anything it's unsure about to a human.

items.label: React · tRPC · Postgres
items.outcome: Pages load instantly · component library the team can extend
items.summary: Rebuilt a slow dashboard from the ground up — page loads went from about 2 seconds to instant. Came with a component library the in-house team can extend without me.

items.label: Shopify · Next.js · Tailwind
items.outcome: Shipped in 6 weeks · custom checkout · loads instantly on mobile
items.summary: Built a custom storefront with a fast checkout flow, mobile-first design, and clean product pages — all in 6 weeks from kickoff to live.

items.label: n8n · OpenAI · webhooks
items.outcome: 12 tools wired together · AI handles the routing
items.summary: Replaced a tangle of manual handoffs with a single automated flow — wires together 12 tools (CRM, email, sheets, Slack, AI), with the AI deciding what gets sent where. Runs in production without losing a record.

items.label: React Native · Expo · Supabase
items.outcome: From idea to App Store in 8 weeks · iOS + Android
items.summary: Designed and shipped a cross-platform app — offline-first sync, push notifications, and a clean onboarding flow. From kickoff to a live App Store / Play Store listing in 8 weeks, one codebase across both.

process.heading: Process
process.lede: Predictable and async-friendly, start to finish.

steps.title: A first message
steps.body: It starts with a paragraph about your project — email or chat, whatever's easiest. Within a day you'll get an honest read on whether I'm the right fit.

steps.title: Scoped proposal
steps.body: Within 48h I send a 1-page proposal: scope, milestones, flat fee, and what's in vs out. You approve or tweak it, and we're set.

steps.title: Steady async updates
steps.body: Steady chat updates, demos when there's something to show. You always know what shipped and what's next.

steps.title: Handoff with docs
steps.body: Code and clear setup docs — everything documented and ready to run. A clean handoff, not a code dump.
